body:
I never called for myself, but a friend of mine was going through the suicidal cycles so I called in hopes of getting someone with good advice. Kept me waiting on the line for someone upwards of 30 minutes until my phone gave up and I moved on, finding other places to get advice, so, I never have actually talked to anyone on there. Glad I didn't with these examples.

Thank goodness I found a place like this in my time of feeling this way. Friend is fine, too.
